Protect
We highly recommend that you use a mattress protector to prevent damage to your Endy.

Clean
Mattresses with foam like the Endy Mattress and Endy Hybrid Mattress can be damaged by contact with liquids, including cleaning products.
To absorb any spilled liquids, dab your mattress gently with a towel, then lean the mattress at an angle with the mattress top facing down to help drain any remaining liquid.
